title: MikroScore KG — Allowed Relation Types
description: Canonical vocabulary of relation types used in data/relations/by-entity/*.json. Derived from actual repo usage. Add new types here before using them in data files.

allowedTypes.description: Ingredient/compound is used for a symptom or health goal
Claim targets a symptom or health outcome
Ingredient is related to another ingredient
Entity has a regulatory status (e.g. EFSA approval)
Entity is supported by or based on a study
Ingredient warrants monitoring a specific biomarker
Ingredient interacts with another ingredient or compound
Ingredient has a known side effect
Ingredient is contraindicated for a condition

notes: All relation types are stored as outgoing from the perspective of the source entity.
Incoming relations may also appear in by-entity files when explicitly authored.
Study targets for basiert_auf_studie use id format: pmid-{PMID} (preferred), studie-{PMID} (legacy), or doi-{doi}.
